purpose: Transparent annual model for two guest suites; not an accountant, payroll, tax or legal forecast

status_vocabulary.working_assumption: Current planning input that remains adjustable
status_vocabulary.simulation_convention: Formula convention used to compare cases consistently
status_vocabulary.quote_or_measurement_required: Must be replaced with an invoice, quote or operating measurement
status_vocabulary.external_validation_required: Requires an accountant, payroll, legal, tax, insurance or regulatory opinion

spa.billing_rule: Every buying stay is billed for each occupied suite day of that stay.
spa.validation: Measure wood, water, consumables, preparation, heating, testing and cleaning time in dry runs.

table_board.validation: Confirm the commercial contents, food-safety scope, alcohol treatment and real preparation time.

tax.interpretation: The standard case uses the VAT franchise as a modifiable planning assumption. Eligibility, thresholds, activity mix and any voluntary election require professional validation.

spa_direct_cost_ttc.note: Working split: about EUR 5 hammam energy and EUR 5 wood per buying suite-day; two buying suites therefore cost about EUR 20 in total.

fixed_operating_costs_ttc.warning: Zero-budget lines are explicit self-provision assumptions, not proof that the economic cost is zero. Each line must be assigned to the operating company, SCI or both according to the lease and actual beneficiary.

associate_contribution_hours.validation: Name, roster and validate the corporate, labor-law and insurance treatment of these hours.

sci_rent.interpretation: The annual model must first demonstrate its ability to support 12,000 EUR. The 18,000 EUR amount is a target, not an automatic rent. Lease terms, market value and tax treatment require professional validation.

annual_remuneration_rate.note: Illustrative tax reference current on 2026-08-09 for relevant closing periods; update before signing. A 10% annual rate is a stress case, not the recommended base.

simulation_method.entity_separation: SCI debt service is paid by SCI cash; operating-company debt service is paid by operating-company cash
simulation_method.accounting_treatment: Interest is separated as a financial expense of the debtor entity; principal repayment is a cash outflow and not an operating expense.

shareholder_current_accounts.warning: The rate is a simulation input, not a promised return. A 10% annual rate can exceed tax deductibility limits and may create an usury-law issue depending on the SCI loan qualification. Convention terms, legal limits, tax treatment, payment subordination and repayment capacity require professional validation.

workload_model.estimated_client_presence_days: 1.2 * nights_per_suite; heuristic pending the real booking calendar
workload_model.spa_service_hours: spa_hours_per_open_day * estimated_spa_open_days; estimated_spa_open_days = presence_days * (1 - (1 - spa_suite_days / (suite_count * presence_days)) ^ suite_count)
workload_model.total_operations_hours: base_property_and_administration_hours + client_presence_hours + occupied_suite_night_hours + stay_coordination_hours + internalized_turnover_hours + spa_service_hours + table_service_hours
workload_model.calendar_support_floor: round_to_50(100 + 2 * nights_per_suite), bounded between 250 and 500 hours
workload_model.warning: Annual totals do not replace a named weekly roster respecting daily and weekly rest. Hours benefiting private property or residents must not be silently charged to the operating company.

activity_tests.label: standard
activity_tests.interpretation: Close to annual workload coverage with 0.8 FTE, 100 paid support hours and 380 declared associate hours; calendar feasibility still requires a real roster.

activity_tests.label: higher_activity_test
activity_tests.interpretation: Improves economic capacity but exceeds the planned annual labor coverage by about 249 hours before calendar constraints; staffing or task design must change.

validation_register: Confirm VAT regime and activity-specific rates before contracts and pricing are frozen.
Obtain the payroll cost and working-time structure for 0.8 FTE Jules.
Validate the lease, the 12,000 EUR rent test and the 18,000 EUR target against market value and cost allocation.
Draft separate SCI and operating-company shareholder-current-account agreements.
Update and validate the adjustable CCA remuneration rate; keep 10% annual only as a legal and tax stress test.
Confirm the local-board unit, contents, food-safety obligations and measured one-hour service assumption.
Measure hammam and Nordic-bath opening days, wood, water, consumables and labor.
Replace each fixed and variable cost with a quote, invoice or dry-run measurement.
Create a named weekly roster for Jules, paid support and associate contribution.
